title: Binance and Recent Changes Shaking Crypto Market
seoTitle: Binance and Recent Changes Shaking Crypto Market
subtitle: Announcements about operation pauses and token delistings raise alerts among investors and underline the need for cautious strategies.
excerpt: Binance, one of the leading cryptocurrency exchanges, announced recent changes that affect the market.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The crypto‑asset market is on high alert after a series of announcements from Binance, one of the sector's main exchanges. The recent news involves both a temporary suspension of certain operations and the delisting of several tokens and trading pairs, creating turbulence and demanding immediate attention from investors.

Pause in operations and altcoin delistings

Binance announced a temporary suspension of specific operations, scheduled for the coming days or later this week, which could briefly interrupt trading and services on the centralized exchange. At the same time, the platform disclosed the delisting of three altcoins — Litecoin (LTC), SUI and BNB — effective from the beginning of September. This measure means the removal of a series of trading pairs involving these assets.

Although the delistings are expected to pressure the prices of the affected crypto assets and reduce liquidity in the discontinued pairs, it is important to note that Litecoin, SUI and BNB will remain tradable through other alternative pairs on Binance itself. The exclusion of certain combinations is presented as part of an ongoing platform‑adjustment process aimed at improving liquidity and user experience, described as a kind of “market cleaning”.

Other digital assets with support terminated

Beyond the latest announcements, Binance had already decided to end support for six digital tokens: ACX, HFT, PIVX, PYR, VANRY and VIC, with an effective date of August 17, 2026. This was the fourth round of removals by the broker this year, bringing the total to 21 delisted assets. Moves like this lead to a sharp drop in liquidity and a pronounced price decline for the tokens, catching many investors off guard.

Psychological and financial impact on investments

The inherent volatility of the cryptocurrency market, which attracts investors with the promise of rapid gains, is the same force that amplifies the negative impact of downturns. The human brain processes losses more intensely than gains, a phenomenon known as loss aversion, which is magnified in the crypto universe. When support is terminated or tokens are delisted, investors may make impulsive decisions, such as selling at a loss out of fear of losing everything, and may experience heightened anxiety and financial stress.

Guidance for traders and users

Binance advises its users to review open positions and pending orders before the delistings take effect. Orders linked to pairs that will be removed will be automatically cancelled, requiring resources to be reallocated in advance to the pairs that remain active. A prior assessment of exposure to the affected pairs is essential to avoid losses and ensure a smoother migration. In a tighter‑liquidity environment, the ability to adapt quickly becomes crucial.

Strategies to protect wealth and well‑being

To navigate turbulent periods with greater clarity and safety, the following strategies are recommended:

  • Reevaluate your strategy: Check whether your investments still align with your long‑term goals.
  • Diversify investments: Avoid concentrating all capital in a single digital asset to mitigate risk.
  • Have an exit plan: Set loss limits and profit targets before buying, preventing fear or greed from dictating actions.
  • Stay calm and study: Decisions made in the heat of the moment are often the worst. Use the time to understand project fundamentals.
  • Take care of mental health: If volatility is causing constant anxiety, consider reducing exposure to high‑risk assets to preserve your well‑being.
